claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, this P-selectin inhibitor is unlikely to kill cells through SELP inhibition; any observed killing would most plausibly reflect a non-selective cytotoxic class effect or physicochemical/off-target toxicity rather than a targeted mechanism.
